provider_receipt.summary: Independent review found unsupported completion and concrete defects. The execute projection contains only an output digest and read-call receipts, not the worker’s reported findings, authority classification, or objective-lineage output, so completion of the source_evidence objective cannot be independently established. The prior verification receipt does cover `git status --short --branch` with exit code 0 and an authenticated output digest; clean-tree is separately recorded as passed. Source defects: `src/lib.rs:184-192` permits absolute paths and `../` traversal in slash-containing wikilinks, allowing resolved backlinks outside the private vault; `src/lib.rs:107-125` ingests every Markdown file without enforcing the documented authority, status, privacy, review, or quarantine rules; `src/lib.rs:56-89` claims to store memory but only serializes and discards the record, providing no durable storage. Tests cover basic link resolution and missing vaults but not vault confinement or ingestion-policy enforcement. No files were modified and no declared checks were rerun.
